242	class Engine:
243	    def __init__(self, store, sb, planner=None, max_steps=200, max_retries=3,
244	                 sleep=time.sleep, crash_after=None, step_delay=0.0):
245	        self.store, self.sb = store, sb
246	        self.planner = planner or (LLMPlanner() if os.getenv("ROOK_PLANNER") == "llm" else RuleBasedPlanner())
247	        self.max_steps, self.max_retries = max_steps, max_retries
248	        self.sleep, self.crash_after, self.step_delay = sleep, crash_after, step_delay
249	        self.executions = 0
250	        self.cancelled = False
251	
252	    def cancel(self):
253	        self.cancelled = True
254	
255	    # ---- INVESTIGATE -> DEFINE CLOSURE -> PLAN -> AUTHORIZE ----
256	    def start(self, subject=None, org="acme", created_by="system", scenario=None, extra_actions=()):
257	        iid = "inc-" + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
258	        with span("incident.start", session=iid, user=created_by, user_meta={"org": org},
259	                  incident=iid, org=org, scenario=scenario or "") as root:
260	            if subject is None:                       # trigger: completed offboarding tickets
261	                done = self.sb.pm.completed_offboardings()
262	                subject = next(iter(done.values()))["subject"] if done else None
263	                if subject is None:
264	                    raise ValueError("no completed offboarding to investigate")
265	            with span("investigate", incident=iid) as sp:
266	                person, rel, graph, finds = investigate(self.sb, subject)
267	                sp.set(accounts=sum(r["rel"] == "has_account" for r in rel),
268	                       active_credentials=sum(r["rel"] == "owns_credential" and r["status"] == "active" for r in rel))
269	            with span("discover.dependencies", incident=iid) as sp:
270	                deps = [d for r in rel if r["rel"] == "owns_credential" for d in r["dependents"]]
271	                sp.retriever("config scan for " + ", ".join(r["fp"] for r in rel if r["rel"] == "owns_credential"),
272	                             deps)
273	                sp.set(dependents=len(deps), unrecorded=sum(len(r.get("unrecorded_dependents", [])) for r in rel
274	                                                            if r["rel"] == "owns_credential"))
275	            inc = Incident(id=iid, org=org, created_by=created_by, subject=subject, scenario=scenario or "custom",
276	                           title=f"Active credential after offboarding: {person.get('name', subject)}",
277	                           relationships=rel, graph=graph, findings=finds,
278	                           exposure=" ".join(f["text"] for f in finds),
279	                           severity="high" if any(f["severity"] == "high" for f in finds) else "medium")
280	            self.store.save_incident(inc)
281	            self.store.audit(iid, "investigated", {"relationships": rel, "findings": [f["text"] for f in finds]})
282	
283	            conds = build_conditions(rel)                  # defined BEFORE any remediation
284	            self.store.save_conditions(iid, conds)
285	            self.store.audit(iid, "closure_conditions_defined", {"conditions": [c.id for c in conds]})
286	
287	            try:
288	                inc.ticket = self.sb.pm.open_ticket(inc.title, subject, f"{iid}:ticket")["ticket"]
289	                self.store.audit(iid, "ticket_opened", {"ticket": inc.ticket})
290	            except (Transient, Timeout, Permanent) as e:   # tracking is best effort, never blocks containment
291	                self.store.audit(iid, "ticket_open_failed", {"error": type(e).__name__})
292	
293	            with span("plan", incident=iid) as sp:
294	                plan = self.planner.plan(rel, iid) + list(extra_actions)
295	                plan = enforce_order(plan)
296	                sp.set(actions=len(plan), planner=type(self.planner).__name__)
297	            # stable ids in execution order; references rewritten accordingly
298	            rename = {a.id: f"{iid}-a{i+1}" for i, a in enumerate(plan)}
299	            seen = set()
300	            for i, a in enumerate(plan):
301	                a.id, a.incident_id = rename[a.id], iid
302	                a.depends_on = [rename[d] for d in a.depends_on]
303	                a.idem_key = f"{iid}:{a.type}:{a.params.get('service','')}:{a.target}"
304	                a.max_retries = self.max_retries
305	            for i, a in enumerate(plan):
306	                with span("policy.decide", incident=iid, action=a.id, action_type=a.type, target=a.target) as sp:
307	                    if a.idem_key in seen:
308	                        decision, reason, rule = "blocked", "Duplicate of another planned action.", "R6-duplicate"
309	                    else:
310	                        decision, reason, rule = policy.decide(a, inc, self.sb, plan)
311	                    sp.set(decision=decision, rule=rule)
312	                    sp.guardrail(f"{a.type} {a.target}", decision != "blocked", f"{decision} ({rule}): {reason}")
313	                seen.add(a.idem_key)
314	                a.policy = {"decision": decision, "reason": reason, "rule": rule}
315	                a.move({"authorized": S.authorized, "needs_approval": S.needs_approval}.get(decision, S.blocked))
316	                self.store.add_action(a, i)
317	                self.store.audit(iid, "policy_" + decision, {"action": a.id, "type": a.type, "target": a.target,
318	                                                             "reason": reason, "rule": rule})
319	                if decision == "blocked":
320	                    self.store.audit(iid, "escalated", {"action": a.id, "reason": reason})
321	            self.store.checkpoint(iid, "planned", {"statuses": {a.id: a.status.value for a in plan}})
322	            inc.status = IS.ready.value         # approval is asked for when the run reaches that step
323	            self.store.save_incident(inc)
324	            root.set(subject=subject, actions=len(plan), status=inc.status)
325	        return inc

327	    # ---- human approval (policy re-checked; approver identity comes from the caller's principal) ----
328	    def approve(self, iid, action_id, principal):
329	        a = self._action(iid, action_id)
330	        if a.status != S.needs_approval:
331	            raise ValueError(f"{action_id} is {a.status.value}, not awaiting approval")
332	        inc = self.store.incident(iid)
333	        approval = {"by": principal.id, "roles": list(principal.roles), "org": principal.org}
334	        with span("approval.decide", session=iid, user=principal.id, user_meta={"org": principal.org},
335	                  incident=iid, action=action_id, approver=principal.id) as sp:
336	            decision, reason, rule = policy.decide(a, inc, self.sb, self.store.actions(iid), approval=approval)
337	            sp.set(decision=decision)
338	            sp.guardrail(f"approve {a.type} {a.target} by {principal.id}", decision == "authorized", reason)
339	        if decision == "authorized":
340	            a.move(S.authorized)
341	            a.policy = {"decision": "authorized", "reason": reason, "rule": rule, "approval": approval}
342	            self.store.approval(iid, a.id, "approved", principal.id, {"reason": reason})
343	            self.store.audit(iid, "approval_granted", {"action": a.id, "by": principal.id})
344	        else:
345	            self.store.approval(iid, a.id, "refused_by_policy", principal.id, {"reason": reason})
346	            self.store.audit(iid, "approval_rejected_by_policy", {"action": a.id, "by": principal.id, "reason": reason})
347	            raise PermissionError(reason)
348	        self.store.save_action(a)
349	        return a

351	    def reject(self, iid, action_id, principal, note=""):
352	        a = self._action(iid, action_id)
353	        if a.status != S.needs_approval:
354	            raise ValueError(f"{action_id} is {a.status.value}, not awaiting approval")
355	        a.move(S.blocked)
356	        a.policy = {**a.policy, "decision": "blocked", "reason": f"Rejected by {principal.id}. {note}".strip()}
357	        self.store.save_action(a)
358	        self.store.approval(iid, a.id, "rejected", principal.id, {"note": note[:500]})
359	        self.store.audit(iid, "approval_rejected", {"action": a.id, "by": principal.id})
360	        return a

362	    def _action(self, iid, action_id):
363	        a = next((x for x in self.store.actions(iid) if x.id == action_id), None)
364	        if a is None:
365	            raise KeyError(action_id)
366	        return a

368	    # ---- EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> CHECKPOINT -> CONTINUE OR RECOVER (resumable from the DB) ----
369	    def run(self, iid):
370	        owner = uuid.uuid4().hex
371	        if not self.store.acquire_run(iid, owner):
372	            raise RunInProgress(iid)
373	        try:
374	            return self._run(iid)
375	        finally:
376	            self.store.release_run(iid, owner)
377	
378	    def _run(self, iid):
379	        steps = 0
380	        inc = self.store.incident(iid)
381	        with span("incident.run", session=iid, user=inc.created_by, user_meta={"org": inc.org},
382	                  incident=iid) as root:
383	            acts = self.store.actions(iid)
384	            inflight = [a.id for a in acts if a.status in (S.executing, S.executed, S.unknown)]
385	            if inflight:
386	                cp = self.store.last_checkpoint(iid)
387	                with span("checkpoint.restore", incident=iid, checkpoint=cp["n"] if cp else 0,
388	                          inflight=len(inflight)):
389	                    log("resuming from checkpoint {checkpoint}", checkpoint=cp["n"] if cp else None,
390	                        in_flight=",".join(inflight))
391	                    self.store.audit(iid, "checkpoint_restored", {"checkpoint": cp["n"] if cp else None,
392	                                                                  "label": cp["label"] if cp else None,
393	                                                                  "in_flight": inflight})
394	            inc.status = IS.remediating.value
395	            self.store.save_incident(inc)
396	            while steps < self.max_steps and not self.cancelled:
397	                acts = self.store.actions(iid)
398	                by_id = {a.id: a for a in acts}
399	                before = {a.id: (a.status, a.retries) for a in acts}
400	                for a in acts:
401	                    if self.cancelled or steps >= self.max_steps:
402	                        break
403	                    if a.status not in RUNNABLE and a.status != S.needs_approval:
404	                        continue
405	                    deps = [by_id[d] for d in a.depends_on]
406	                    bad = [d for d in deps if d.status in UNRESOLVED_BAD]
407	                    if a.status == S.needs_approval and not bad:
408	                        continue                          # waits for a person
409	                    if bad and a.status in (S.authorized, S.retry_pending, S.needs_approval):
410	                        a.move(S.blocked)
411	                        a.policy = {**a.policy, "decision": "blocked", "rule": "R4-safe-order",
412	                                    "reason": "Not run because " + ", ".join(f"{d.id} ({d.type}) is {d.status.value}"
413	                                                                             for d in bad) + "."}
414	                        self.store.save_action(a)
415	                        self.store.audit(iid, "blocked_by_dependency", {"action": a.id, "waiting_on": [d.id for d in bad]})
416	                        continue
417	                    if not all(d.status == S.verified for d in deps):
418	                        continue                          # waiting (e.g. on approval or a sibling step)
419	                    while a.status in RUNNABLE and steps < self.max_steps and not self.cancelled:
420	                        steps += 1
421	                        halt = self._step(a)
422	                        self.store.save_action(a)
423	                        self.store.checkpoint(iid, "step", {"step": steps, "action": a.id, "status": a.status.value,
424	                                                            "statuses": {x.id: (a if x.id == a.id else x).status.value
425	                                                                         for x in acts}})
426	                        by_id[a.id] = a
427	                        if self.step_delay:
428	                            time.sleep(self.step_delay)
429	                        if halt:
430	                            break
431	                after = {a.id: (a.status, a.retries) for a in self.store.actions(iid)}
432	                if after == before:
433	                    break
434	            for a in self.store.actions(iid):
435	                if a.status in (S.failed, S.unknown):
436	                    self.store.audit(iid, "escalated", {"action": a.id, "status": a.status.value,
437	                                                        "reason": a.result.get("error", "outcome could not be established")})
438	            if self.cancelled:
439	                self.store.audit(iid, "cancelled", {})
440	            rep = self.finalize(iid)
441	            root.set(status=rep["status"], steps=steps)
442	            return rep
443	
444	    def _step(self, a):
445	        iid = a.incident_id
446	        attempt = a.retries + 1
447	        if a.status in (S.executing, S.unknown):
448	            # outcome uncertain: inspect real state BEFORE any new mutation
449	            with span("reconcile", incident=iid, action=a.id, action_type=a.type, attempt=a.retries) as sp:
450	                landed = applied(self.sb, a)
451	                sp.set(applied=landed)
452	                log("inspected live state for {action}: applied={applied}", action=a.id, applied=str(landed))
453	            if landed is True:
454	                ok, ev = verify_action(self.sb, a)
455	                a.evidence = ev
456	                if ok is True:
457	                    a.move(S.verified)
458	                    self.store.audit(iid, "reconciled_verified", {"action": a.id, "evidence": ev})
459	                elif ok is False:
460	                    a.move(S.failed)
461	                    a.result = {**a.result, "error": "Change landed but independent verification failed."}
462	                    self.store.audit(iid, "reconciled_but_verification_failed", {"action": a.id, "evidence": ev})
463	                    if a.type == "update_dependent":
464	                        self._compensate(a)
465	                else:
466	                    a.move(S.unknown)
467	                    self.store.audit(iid, "reconcile_inconclusive", {"action": a.id, "evidence": ev})
468	                    return True
469	            elif landed is False:
470	                if a.retries > a.max_retries:
471	                    a.move(S.failed)
472	                    a.result = {**a.result, "error": f"Gave up after {a.retries} failed attempts."}
473	                    self.store.audit(iid, "failed_retries_exhausted", {"action": a.id, "attempts": a.retries})
474	                else:
475	                    a.move(S.retry_pending)
476	                    self.store.audit(iid, "reconciled_not_applied", {"action": a.id, "safe_to_retry": True})
477	            else:
478	                a.move(S.unknown)
479	                self.store.audit(iid, "reconcile_inconclusive", {"action": a.id})
480	                return True
481	            return False
482	
483	        if a.status in (S.authorized, S.retry_pending):
484	            inc = self.store.incident(iid)
485	            with span("policy.recheck", incident=iid, action=a.id, action_type=a.type) as sp:
486	                decision, reason, rule = policy.decide(a, inc, self.sb, self.store.actions(iid),
487	                                                       approval=a.policy.get("approval"))
488	                sp.set(decision=decision, rule=rule)
489	                sp.guardrail(f"pre-execution check {a.type} {a.target}", decision == "authorized", reason)
490	            if decision != "authorized":
491	                a.move(S.blocked)
492	                a.policy = {**a.policy, "decision": "blocked", "reason": reason, "rule": rule}
493	                self.store.audit(iid, "policy_recheck_blocked", {"action": a.id, "reason": reason})
494	                return True
495	            a.move(S.executing)
496	            self.store.save_action(a)
497	            self.store.audit(iid, "executing", {"action": a.id, "attempt": attempt})
498	            try:
499	                with span("execute", incident=iid, action=a.id, action_type=a.type, target=a.target,
500	                          adapter=a.params.get("service"), attempt=attempt) as sp:
501	                    sp.tool(f"{a.params.get('service')}.{a.type}", TOOL_DOCS.get(a.type, a.type),
502	                            {"target": a.target, "idempotency_key": a.idem_key, "attempt": attempt})
503	                    a.result = self._exec(a)
504	                    sp.set(outcome="ok", replayed=bool(a.result.get("replayed")))
505	                self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, attempt, "ok", a.result)
506	                self.executions += 1
507	                if self.crash_after is not None and self.executions >= self.crash_after:
508	                    raise SimulatedCrash()    # after mutation, before status is persisted
509	                a.move(S.executed)
510	                self.store.audit(iid, "executed", {"action": a.id, "result": a.result})
511	            except (Transient, Timeout) as e:
512	                a.retries += 1
513	                kind = "timeout" if isinstance(e, Timeout) else "transient"
514	                a.result = {"error": f"{kind}: {e}"}
515	                a.move(S.unknown)
516	                log("{action} attempt {attempt} failed ({kind}); checkpointing before inspecting state",
517	                    level="warning", action=a.id, attempt=attempt, kind=kind)
518	                self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, attempt, kind, {"error": str(e)})
519	                self.store.audit(iid, f"{kind}_failure", {"action": a.id, "attempt": attempt, "error": str(e),
520	                                                          "next": "checkpoint, then inspect real state before retrying"})
521	                self.sleep(0.05 * 2 ** a.retries)
522	            except Permanent as e:
523	                a.move(S.failed)
524	                a.result = {"error": str(e)}
525	                self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, attempt, "permanent", {"error": str(e)})
526	                self.store.audit(iid, "permanent_failure", {"action": a.id, "error": str(e)})
527	            except Exception as e:
528	                a.move(S.failed)
529	                a.result = {"error": type(e).__name__}
530	                self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, attempt, "error", {"error": type(e).__name__})
531	                self.store.audit(iid, "unexpected_failure", {"action": a.id, "error": type(e).__name__})
532	            return False
533	
534	        if a.status == S.executed:
535	            with span("verify", incident=iid, action=a.id, action_type=a.type) as sp:
536	                ok, ev = verify_action(self.sb, a)
537	                sp.set(result="pass" if ok else "fail" if ok is False else "inconclusive")
538	                sp.guardrail(f"independent check of {a.type} {a.target}", ok is True, json.dumps(ev))
539	            a.evidence = ev
540	            if ok is True:
541	                a.move(S.verified)
542	            elif ok is False:
543	                a.move(S.failed)
544	                a.result = {**a.result, "error": "The tool reported success but independent verification failed."}
545	            else:
546	                a.move(S.unknown)
547	            self.store.audit(iid, "verification_" + a.status.value, {"action": a.id, "evidence": ev})
548	            if a.status == S.failed and a.type == "update_dependent":
549	                self._compensate(a)
550	        return False

552	    def _exec(self, a):
553	        p = a.params
554	        if a.type == "disable_account":
555	            return self.sb.account_service(p["service"]).disable(a.target, a.idem_key)
556	        if a.type == "issue_replacement":
557	            return self.sb.vault.issue_replacement(a.target, a.idem_key)
558	        if a.type == "update_dependent":
559	            return self.sb.update_dependent(a.target, p["cred_id"], a.idem_key)
560	        if a.type == "revoke_credential":
561	            return self.sb.vault.revoke(a.target, p["version"], a.idem_key)
562	        if a.type == "scrub_exposed_secret":
563	            return self.sb.github.scrub_secret(a.target, p["old_fp"], a.idem_key)
564	        raise Permanent("unsupported action")

566	    # ---- compensation: undo a dependent update that broke the service ----
567	    def _compensate(self, a):
568	        iid = a.incident_id
569	        inc = self.store.incident(iid)
570	        ok, reason = policy.may_compensate(self.sb, a, inc)
571	        if not ok:
572	            self.store.audit(iid, "rollback_skipped", {"action": a.id, "reason": reason})
573	            return
574	        with span("rollback", incident=iid, action=a.id, target=a.target) as sp:
575	            sp.tool(f"{a.params.get('service')}.restore_dependent", "Put a service back on its previous, still-valid key",
576	                    {"target": a.target, "version": a.params["old_version"]})
577	            try:
578	                res = self.sb.restore_dependent(a.target, a.params["cred_id"], a.params["old_version"],
579	                                                f"{a.idem_key}:rollback")
580	            except (Transient, Timeout, Permanent) as e:
581	                self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, a.retries + 1, "rollback_failed", {"error": str(e)})
582	                self.store.audit(iid, "rollback_failed", {"action": a.id, "error": str(e)})
583	                sp.guardrail(f"rollback {a.target}", False, str(e))
584	                return
585	            healthy = self.sb.health(a.target)
586	            sp.guardrail(f"rollback {a.target} restores service", healthy, json.dumps({"healthy": healthy}))
587	        self.store.tool_call(iid, a.id, a.retries + 1, "rollback_ok", res)
588	        a.result = {**a.result, "rolled_back": True, "healthy_after_rollback": healthy}
589	        self.store.audit(iid, "rolled_back", {"action": a.id, "target": a.target, "reason": reason,
590	                                              "healthy_after_rollback": healthy})

592	    # ---- Verified Closure: live re-observation against pre-defined conditions ----
593	    def report(self, iid, live=False):
594	        inc = self.store.incident(iid)
595	        acts = self.store.actions(iid)
596	        stored = self.store.conditions(iid)
597	        conds = evaluate(self.sb, stored) if live else stored
598	        mandatory = [c for c in conds if c.mandatory]
599	        events = self.store.audit_events(iid)
600	        names = [e["event"] for e in events]
601	        first_exec = names.index("executing") if "executing" in names else len(names)
602	        inv = {
603	            "closure_conditions_defined": bool(stored),
604	            "conditions_defined_before_remediation": "closure_conditions_defined" in names[:first_exec],
605	            "no_inconclusive_conditions": bool(stored) and all(c.result is not None for c in mandatory),
606	            "all_mandatory_conditions_pass": bool(stored) and all(c.result is True for c in mandatory),
607	            "all_actions_verified": bool(acts) and all(a.status == S.verified for a in acts),
608	            "audit_chain_intact": self.store.verify_chain()[0],
609	        }
610	        closed = all(inv.values())
611	        bad = [c.id for c in conds if c.mandatory and c.result is not True]
612	        unresolved = [{"action": a.id, "type": a.type, "target": a.target, "status": a.status.value,
613	                       "reason": a.policy.get("reason") if a.status in (S.blocked, S.needs_approval)
614	                       else a.result.get("error", "not run yet")}
615	                      for a in acts if a.status != S.verified]
616	        calls = self.store.tool_calls(iid)
617	        by_id = {a.id: a for a in acts}
618	        dead_at = next((e["ts"] for e in events if e["event"] in ("verification_verified", "reconciled_verified")
619	                        and by_id.get(e["data"].get("action")) is not None
620	                        and by_id[e["data"]["action"]].type == "revoke_credential"), None)
621	        if inc.status in (IS.ready.value, IS.investigating.value) and not calls:
622	            status = inc.status
623	        elif closed:
624	            status = IS.closed_verified.value
625	        elif any(a.status in UNRESOLVED_BAD for a in acts) or (bad and all(c.result is not None for c in mandatory)
626	                                                               and all(a.status == S.verified for a in acts)):
627	            status = IS.escalated.value
628	        elif any(a.status == S.needs_approval for a in acts):
629	            status = IS.awaiting_approval.value
630	        else:
631	            status = IS.open.value
632	        return {
633	            "incident": inc.model_dump(mode="json"),
634	            "status": status,
635	            "summary": summarize(inc, acts, status, bad),
636	            "exposure": inc.exposure,
637	            "invariants": inv,
638	            "conditions": [c.model_dump(mode="json") for c in conds],
639	            "actions": [{"id": a.id, "type": a.type, "target": a.target, "service": a.params.get("service"),
640	                         "status": a.status.value,
641	                         "depends_on": a.depends_on, "summary": a.summary, "risk": a.risk,
642	                         "retries": a.retries, "policy": a.policy, "result": a.result,
643	                         "evidence": a.evidence} for a in acts],
644	            "approvals": self.store.approvals(iid),
645	            "follow_ups": follow_ups(inc, acts),
646	            "tool_calls": calls,
647	            "unresolved": unresolved,
648	            "closure_blocked_reason": None if closed else blocked_reason(inv, bad, unresolved),
649	            "metrics": {"tool_calls": len(calls),
650	                        "failed_tool_calls": sum(c["outcome"] not in ("ok", "rollback_ok") for c in calls),
651	                        "retries": sum(a.retries for a in acts),
652	                        "checkpoints": len(self.store.checkpoints(iid)),
653	                        "audit_events": len(events),
654	                        "rollbacks": sum(1 for a in acts if a.result.get("rolled_back")),
655	                        "seconds_until_old_key_dead": round(dead_at - inc.created_at, 1) if dead_at else None,
656	                        "seconds_until_closed": round(inc.closed_at - inc.created_at, 1) if inc.closed_at else None},
657	        }

659	    def finalize(self, iid):
660	        with span("closure.evaluate", incident=iid) as sp:
661	            rep = self.report(iid, live=True)
662	            sp.set(status=rep["status"], passed=sum(c["result"] is True for c in rep["conditions"]),
663	                   total=len(rep["conditions"]))
664	            sp.guardrail("Verified Closure: " + ", ".join(c["id"] for c in rep["conditions"]),
665	                         rep["status"] == IS.closed_verified.value, rep["closure_blocked_reason"] or rep["summary"])
666	        self.store.save_conditions(iid, [Condition(**c) for c in rep["conditions"]])
667	        inc = self.store.incident(iid)
668	        inc.status = rep["status"]
669	        if rep["status"] == IS.closed_verified.value:
670	            inc.closed_at = inc.closed_at or time.time()
671	            rep["metrics"]["seconds_until_closed"] = round(inc.closed_at - inc.created_at, 1)
672	        self.store.save_incident(inc)
673	        self.store.audit(iid, "incident_" + rep["status"], {"invariants": rep["invariants"],
674	                                                            "blocked_reason": rep["closure_blocked_reason"]})
675	        if inc.ticket and rep["status"] in (IS.closed_verified.value, IS.escalated.value):
676	            try:
677	                self.sb.pm.comment(inc.ticket, rep["summary"], f"{iid}:comment:{rep['status']}")
678	                self.sb.pm.set_status(inc.ticket, "done" if rep["status"] == IS.closed_verified.value else "escalated",
679	                                      f"{iid}:status:{rep['status']}")
680	                self.store.audit(iid, "ticket_updated", {"ticket": inc.ticket, "status": rep["status"]})
681	            except (Transient, Timeout, Permanent) as e:

687	def follow_ups(inc, acts):
688	    """Work Rook deliberately leaves to a person, so nothing is silently dropped."""
689	    out = []
690	    for r in inc.relationships:
691	        if r["rel"] == "ownerless_account":
692	            out.append(f"Assign an owner to, or remove, the ownerless {r['service']} account '{r['user']}'.")
693	    if any(a.type == "scrub_exposed_secret" and a.status == S.verified for a in acts):
694	        paths = [a.target for a in acts if a.type == "scrub_exposed_secret"]
695	        out.append(f"Git history of {', '.join(paths)} still contains the revoked key. It no longer works; "
696	                   "rewrite history only if policy requires it.")
697	    for a in acts:
698	        if a.result.get("rolled_back"):
699	            out.append(f"{a.target} was rolled back to the previous key after its update failed. Fix the service, "
700	                       "then run the incident again.")
701	    return out

704	def evidence_pack(rep, audit, chain):
705	    """Markdown evidence for auditors: what happened, who approved, what was verified, and integrity."""
706	    inc = rep["incident"]
707	    L = [f"# Incident evidence: {inc['id']}", "",
708	         f"- Title: {inc['title']}", f"- Status: **{rep['status']}**", f"- Organisation: {inc['org']}",
709	         f"- Opened by: {inc['created_by']}", f"- Tracking ticket: {inc.get('ticket') or 'none'}",
710	         f"- Old key dead after: {rep['metrics']['seconds_until_old_key_dead']} s",
711	         f"- Closed after: {rep['metrics']['seconds_until_closed']} s", "",
712	         "## Summary", rep["summary"], "", "## Findings"]
713	    L += [f"- [{f['severity']}] {f['text']}" for f in inc["findings"]]
714	    L += ["", "## Actions", "| # | Action | Target | Status | Attempts | Policy |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
715	    L += [f"| {i+1} | {a['type']} | {a['target']} | {a['status']} | {a['retries'] + 1} | {a['policy'].get('rule')} |"
716	          for i, a in enumerate(rep["actions"])]
717	    L += ["", "## Approvals"] + ([f"- {x['decision']} by {x['by']} ({x['action']})" for x in rep["approvals"]] or ["- none"])
718	    L += ["", "## Closure checks (independently observed)", "| Check | Result | Evidence |", "|---|---|---|"]
719	    L += [f"| {c['description']} | {'PASS' if c['result'] else 'FAIL' if c['result'] is False else 'INCONCLUSIVE'} | "
720	          f"`{json.dumps(c['evidence'])}` |" for c in rep["conditions"]]
721	    L += ["", "## Invariants"] + [f"- {k}: {'yes' if v else 'no'}" for k, v in rep["invariants"].items()]
722	    L += ["", "## Follow-ups for a person"] + ([f"- {x}" for x in rep["follow_ups"]] or ["- none"])
723	    L += ["", "## Audit integrity",
724	          f"Hash chain over {chain[2]} audit events: {'intact' if chain[0] else f'BROKEN at event {chain[1]}'}.",
725	          f"Last event hash for this incident: `{audit[-1]['hash'] if audit else 'n/a'}`", "",
726	          "## Timeline"]
727	    L += [f"- {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S', time.gmtime(e['ts']))}Z {e['event']}" for e in audit]
728	    L += ["", "_Sandboxed mock integrations, synthetic credentials only._"]
729	    return "\n".join(L) + "\n"

732	def blocked_reason(inv, bad, unresolved):
733	    out = []
734	    if bad:
735	        out.append("checks not satisfied: " + ", ".join(bad))
736	    if unresolved:
737	        out.append("unfinished actions: " + ", ".join(f"{u['action']} {u['type']} ({u['status']})" for u in unresolved))
738	    failed = [k for k, v in inv.items() if not v]
739	    if not out and failed:
740	        out.append("failed invariants: " + ", ".join(failed))
741	    return "; ".join(out) or "not yet evaluated"

744	def summarize(inc, acts, status, bad):
745	    done = sum(a.status == S.verified for a in acts)
746	    if status == IS.closed_verified.value:
747	        return (f"Closed with evidence: all {len(acts)} actions were independently verified and every closure "
748	                "check passed. The old key is rejected, the replacement works, and every dependent is healthy.")
749	    if status == IS.awaiting_approval.value:
750	        waiting = [a for a in acts if a.status == S.needs_approval]
751	        return (f"{done} of {len(acts)} actions verified. Waiting for a person to approve: "
752	                + "; ".join(a.summary for a in waiting))
753	    if status == IS.escalated.value:
754	        probs = [f"{a.id} {a.type} on {a.target} is {a.status.value}" for a in acts if a.status in UNRESOLVED_BAD]
755	        return ("Escalated to a human: Rook could not finish safely and will not claim success. "
756	                + ("; ".join(probs) + ". " if probs else "")
757	                + (f"Failing checks: {', '.join(bad)}." if bad else ""))
758	    return f"{done} of {len(acts)} actions verified so far."

362	    def mutate(self, op, idem, fn):
363	        """Idempotency + deterministic failure injection for every state change."""
364	        self.s["calls"] += 1
365	        if idem in self.s["applied"]:
366	            self._save()

370	        if kind == "transient":
371	            self._save(); raise Transient(f"{op}: 503 service unavailable")

373	            self._save(); raise Permanent(f"{op}: permission denied")
374	        if kind == "timeout_lost":        # request lost, nothing applied
375	            self._save(); raise Timeout(op)

378	        self.s["applied"][idem] = res
379	        self._save()
380	        if kind == "timeout_applied":     # applied, but the caller never saw the response
381	            raise Timeout(op)

import json

from rook import verification
from rook.domain import Action, InvalidTransition, Principal, Status
from rook.engine import Engine, RuleBasedPlanner, RunInProgress, SimulatedCrash, make_action
from rook.sandbox import Sandbox, OLD

nosleep = lambda s: None
APPROVER = Principal(id="u-approver", org="acme", roles=["analyst", "approver"])
ANALYST = Principal(id="u-analyst", org="acme", roles=["analyst"])


def mk(path=":memory:", scenario="clean", failures=None, flags=None, **kw):
    st = Store(path)
    sb = Sandbox(st, scenario=scenario, failures=failures, flags=flags)
    return st, sb, Engine(st, sb, sleep=nosleep, **kw)


def acts(st, iid):
    return {(a.type, a.target): a for a in st.actions(iid)}


def revoke_of(st, iid):
    return next(a for a in st.actions(iid) if a.type == "revoke_credential")


def go(e, approve=True):
    """Start, run until approval is needed, approve the revocation, run to the end."""
    inc = e.start()
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    if approve and rep["status"] == "awaiting_approval":
        e.approve(inc.id, revoke_of(e.store, inc.id).id, APPROVER)
        rep = e.run(inc.id)
    return inc.id, rep

"""Service outage playbook: bad deploy -> pause pipeline -> roll back -> verify -> resume with the bad revision blocked."""
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from rook.api import DEMO_TOKENS, create_app
from rook.domain import Principal
from rook.engine import Engine, make_action
from rook.playbooks import Outage, PLAYBOOKS
from rook.sandbox import Sandbox
from rook.store import Store

nosleep = lambda s: None
APPROVER = Principal(id="u-approver", org="acme", roles=["analyst", "approver"])


def mk(scenario="outage_clean", failures=None, flags=None, **kw):
    st = Store(":memory:")
    sb = Sandbox(st, scenario=scenario, failures=failures, flags=flags)
    return st, sb, Engine(st, sb, sleep=nosleep, **kw)


def by_type(rep):
    return {a["type"]: a for a in rep["actions"]}


def events(st, iid):
    return [x["event"] for x in st.audit_events(iid)]


def test_playbooks_registered():
    assert set(PLAYBOOKS) == {"offboarding", "outage"}


def test_investigation_finds_bad_deploy_and_trap():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_clean")
    assert inc.playbook == "outage" and inc.subject == "cloud:checkout-api"     # found from the open alert
    rel = {r["rel"]: r for r in inc.relationships}
    assert rel["deploy"]["revision"] == 42 and rel["deploy"]["minutes_before_alert"] == 1
    assert rel["deploy"]["changed"] == {"DB_HOST": ["db-primary", "db-replica-old"]}
    assert rel["known_good"]["revision"] == 41
    assert rel["pipeline"]["auto_deploy"] and rel["pipeline"]["desired"] == 42
    assert any(r["rel"] == "downstream" and r["caller"] == "app:storefront" for r in inc.relationships)
    text = " ".join(f["text"] for f in inc.findings)
    assert "decommissioned" in text and "overwritten" in text
    assert [a.type for a in st.actions(inc.id)] == ["pause_pipeline", "rollback_service", "resume_pipeline"]
    assert "closure_conditions_defined" in events(st, inc.id)
    assert all(c.result is None for c in st.conditions(inc.id))


def test_clean_outage_closes_with_evidence():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_clean")
    assert not sb.cloud.service_healthy("checkout-api")
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    assert rep["status"] == "closed_verified"
    assert all(c["result"] is True for c in rep["conditions"]) and len(rep["conditions"]) == 7
    assert sb.cloud.deployment("checkout-api")["current"] == 41
    p = sb.cloud.pipeline("checkout-api")
    assert p["auto_deploy"] and p["blocked"] == [42] and p["desired"] == 41
    assert rep["metrics"]["seconds_to_contain"] is not None and rep["metrics"]["contain_label"] == "Service restored after"
    assert any("blocked from redeploying" in f for f in rep["follow_ups"])
    assert sb.pm.tickets()[rep["incident"]["ticket"]]["status"] == "done"


def test_ambiguous_rollback_is_reconciled_not_resent():
    st, sb, e = mk("outage")
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage")
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    assert rep["status"] == "closed_verified"
    rb = by_type(rep)["rollback_service"]
    assert rb["retries"] == 1
    ev = events(st, inc.id)
    assert "timeout_failure" in ev and "reconciled_verified" in ev
    assert [c["outcome"] for c in rep["tool_calls"] if c["action"] == rb["id"]] == ["timeout"]   # never re-sent


def test_wrong_cause_escalates_and_keeps_pipeline_paused():
    st, sb, e = mk("outage_wrong_cause")
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_wrong_cause")
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    a = by_type(rep)
    assert rep["status"] == "escalated"
    assert a["rollback_service"]["status"] == "failed" and a["resume_pipeline"]["status"] == "blocked"
    assert not sb.cloud.pipeline("checkout-api")["auto_deploy"]       # not resumed into a broken state
    assert any("not the whole cause" in f for f in rep["follow_ups"])
    assert any("still paused on purpose" in f for f in rep["follow_ups"])


def test_rollback_api_down_bounded_then_escalated():
    st, sb, e = mk("outage_rollback_down")
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_rollback_down")
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    rb = by_type(rep)["rollback_service"]
    assert rep["status"] == "escalated" and rb["status"] == "failed" and rb["retries"] == 4
    assert sb.cloud.deployment("checkout-api")["current"] == 42


def test_pipeline_redeploys_over_unpaused_rollback():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    res = sb.cloud.rollback("checkout-api", 41, "manual-1")
    assert res["pipeline_redeployed"] == 42 and sb.cloud.deployment("checkout-api")["current"] == 42


class NoPause(Outage):
    def plan(self, rel, iid):
        return [a for a in super().plan(rel, iid) if a.type != "pause_pipeline"]


def test_policy_blocks_rollback_without_pause():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    e.planner = NoPause()
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_clean")
    rb = next(a for a in st.actions(inc.id) if a.type == "rollback_service")
    assert rb.status.value == "blocked" and rb.policy["rule"] == "R4-safe-order"
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    assert rep["status"] == "escalated" and sb.cloud.deployment("checkout-api")["current"] == 42


def test_rollback_to_unproven_revision_needs_approval():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    sb.s["cloud"]["deployments"]["checkout-api"]["revisions"]["41"]["healthy_minutes"] = 70
    sb.s["cloud"]["deployments"]["checkout-api"]["revisions"]["40"] = {
        "env": {"DB_HOST": "db-primary"}, "deployed_at": "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z", "deployed_by": "x",
        "commit": "aaa", "message": "", "healthy_minutes": 10}

    class ToForty(Outage):
        def plan(self, rel, iid):
            acts = super().plan(rel, iid)
            for a in acts:
                if a.type == "rollback_service":
                    a.params["to_revision"] = 40
                if a.type == "resume_pipeline":
                    a.params["expect_revision"] = 40
            return acts
    e.planner = ToForty()
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_clean")
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    rb = by_type(rep)["rollback_service"]
    assert rep["status"] == "awaiting_approval" and rb["policy"]["rule"] == "R8-known-good"
    e.approve(inc.id, rb["id"], APPROVER)
    rep = e.run(inc.id)
    assert rep["status"] == "closed_verified" and sb.cloud.deployment("checkout-api")["current"] == 40


def test_resume_blocked_while_bad_revision_runs():
    st, sb, e = mk()
    inc = e.start(scenario="outage_clean")
    res = next(a for a in st.actions(inc.id) if a.type == "resume_pipeline")
    from rook import policy
    rb = next(a for a in st.actions(inc.id) if a.type == "rollback_service")
    rb.status = rb.status.__class__("failed")
    d, _, rule = policy.decide(res, inc, sb, [rb, res])
    assert d == "blocked" and rule == "R4-safe-order"


def test_outage_over_http(tmp_path):
    app = create_app(db_path=str(tmp_path / "api.db"), tokens=DEMO_TOKENS, step_delay=0, background=False)
    H = {"Authorization": "Bearer demo-analyst-token"}
    with TestClient(app) as c:
        sc = {s["name"]: s["playbook"] for s in c.get("/api/scenarios", headers=H).json()}
        assert sc["outage"] == "outage" and sc["signature"] == "offboarding"
        assert {p["key"] for p in c.get("/api/playbooks", headers=H).json()} == {"offboarding", "outage"}
        iid = c.post("/api/incidents", json={"scenario": "outage"}, headers=H).json()["id"]
        assert c.post(f"/api/incidents/{iid}/run", headers=H).status_code == 202
        body = c.get(f"/api/incidents/{iid}", headers=H).json()
        assert body["report"]["status"] == "closed_verified" and body["report"]["playbook"]["key"] == "outage"
        assert c.get("/api/incidents", headers=H).json()[0]["playbook"] == "outage"
        md = c.get(f"/api/incidents/{iid}/evidence", headers=H).text
        assert "Service outage" in md and "Service restored after" in md

**The operations agent that proves the fix.**

Rook is B2B software for growing companies. It automates the operational incidents that today need IT, security or operations people to investigate, then coordinate fixes across several systems. Rook investigates, acts in a safe order, recovers when a step fails, and checks the result independently. It closes an incident only when evidence shows every closure condition holds. We call this **Verified Closure**. Rook is built by the Keywarden team.

> Every integration in this repository is a **sandboxed mock** with synthetic credentials (`sk_test_SYNTH_*`). This is a hackathon build for neatHack 2026 and is not production-ready.

## Who it is for

| Customer | Typical incidents | Rook today |
|---|---|---|
| Startups and SMEs | Employee and contractor offboarding, access management, routine IT incidents | **Access & offboarding** playbook |
| Mid-sized companies | Cloud outages, service recovery, compliance checks | **Service outage** playbook |
| Larger enterprises | Complex incident response across many connected systems | Same engine; more playbooks and real connectors |

We start with IT incident resolution and access management for growing companies. There's a clear buyer (the head of IT or ops), a problem they recognise, and a demo that shows Rook acting, recovering and verifying.

## Playbooks

The engine is the same for every incident: investigate, define closure, plan, authorize, execute, reconcile, verify, then close or escalate. A playbook (`rook/playbooks.py`) supplies what differs: the trigger, what to read, the remediation plan and the closure checks.

| Playbook | Trigger | What Rook does | Closure checks |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Access & offboarding** | A completed offboarding ticket | Disables leftover accounts, issues a replacement key, moves every service onto it, revokes the old key (with approval), and removes the leaked key from code | 13 |
| **Service outage** | A monitoring alert | Ties the alert to the deploy that caused it, pauses auto-deploy, rolls back to a known-good revision, checks that customers can check out, then resumes the pipeline with the bad revision blocked | 7 |

## Old problems, and how Rook handles each

| The usual problem | What Rook does | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Offboarding disables the person but leaves their keys and side accounts alive | Starts from the closed offboarding ticket and sweeps the directory, three account systems and the vault | `playbooks.investigate` |
| Nobody knows everything that uses a key, and the vault's records are incomplete | Scans live app and cloud config by key fingerprint, and found `payments-worker`, which the vault never listed | `sandbox.dependents_of_fp` |
| Rotating a key causes an outage | Issues the replacement first, moves every service, verifies each one and revokes last. The order is enforced in code | `engine.enforce_order`, policy R4 |
| A botched update takes a service down mid-incident | Automatically rolls that service back to the old, still-valid key and holds the revocation | `Engine._compensate`, policy R7 |
| An outage alert fires and people spend the first half hour working out what changed | Lines the alert up against deploy history and config diffs, and names the suspect revision and the database it can't reach | `playbooks.investigate_outage` |
| A manual rollback gets overwritten by auto-deploy | Pauses the pipeline before rolling back. Policy refuses a rollback while auto-deploy would undo it | policy R4, `cloud.rollback` |
| The pipeline is frozen during an incident and nobody unfreezes it | Resuming the pipeline is part of the plan and a closure check. If Rook can't resume safely, it says so as a follow-up | `resume_pipeline` |
| "We rolled back, so it's fixed" | Closure needs the service healthy, errors normal, callers healthy and a synthetic order placed. If a rollback doesn't help, Rook escalates and says the deploy isn't the whole cause | `verification.outage_conditions` |
| Rolling back to a revision nobody trusts | Rolls back on its own only to a revision with a healthy track record. Anything else needs an approver | policy R8 |
| Scripts retry blindly and double-apply, or give up silently | Every failure is checkpointed and the real state inspected before a retry. Retries are bounded, then Rook escalates | `Engine._step` |
| The tool said "success" and the ticket was closed | Closure is decided by independent probes (authentication, health, regression, error rate, config), never by the tool's reply | `verification.py` |
| The leaked key stays in the repo and scanners keep firing | After revocation, Rook replaces the dead key in the file and flags the git history as a follow-up | `scrub_exposed_secret` |
| Orphaned accounts nobody owns | Rook flags them for a person and never acts on access it can't attribute | `follow_ups` |
| Risky actions without sign-off | Irreversible or unproven steps need an approver from the same org, and policy is re-checked just before execution | `policy.py` |
| Audit evidence is scattered and editable | Rook keeps an append-only, hash-chained audit log. A broken chain blocks closure. There's a one-click Markdown evidence pack | `store.verify_chain`, `/evidence` |
| No incident metrics | Rook records time to contain (old key dead, or service restored), time to close, retries, rollbacks and checkpoints | `report.metrics` |

# Demo scenario and script

## What the main demo shows

Scenario `signature`: billing-app's config API returns one 503 while Rook moves the app to the new key.

The real terminal run (`python -m rook.demo`, full JSON in [runs/after-signature.json](runs/after-signature.json)) produced:

- status `closed_verified`, 13/13 closure checks passing
- 8 tool calls: 1 failed (503), 1 retry, 0 steps where a dependent was down. The 8th call removes the dead key from `billing-api/.env.test`
- Audit sequence around the failure: `executing (attempt 1)` → `transient_failure` → checkpoint saved → `reconciled_not_applied` (Rook confirmed the config was unchanged, so a retry was safe) → `executing (attempt 2)` → `executed` → `verification_verified`

The other outcomes, from real runs in [runs/](runs/):

| Scenario | Result | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `persistent` | escalated, 9/13 checks | billing-app update failed 4 times, so revocation never ran and billing stayed healthy |
| `ambiguous_applied` | closed, 13/13 | Timeout, but inspection showed the change had landed, so there was no retry |
| `revoke_noop` | escalated, 11/13 | The vault said "revoked" but the old key still authenticates |
| `regression_fail` | escalated, 12/13 | billing-app is healthy but its regression suite fails |
| `faulty_update` | escalated, 9/13 | billing-app stored a wrong key and was down for 1 step. Rook rolled it back to the old, still-valid key and held the revocation |

## Video script (under 3 minutes)

1. **0:00–0:15 Problem.** "A contractor left yesterday. Their account is disabled, but the payments API key they created still works. It's in a repo, and two services depend on it." Show the sandbox banner.
2. **0:15–0:45 Investigate.** Start the `signature` incident. Point at the graph (person → accounts, key → billing-app and payments-worker → repo) and the findings. Call out that "payments-worker isn't in vault metadata; Rook found it by scanning config."
3. **0:45–1:05 Plan and policy.** Walk the plan in safe order: replace, move both services, then revoke. Note the 13 closure checks defined before any change.
4. **1:05–1:40 Failure and recovery.** Click **Run plan**. The timeline shows the 503. In the failure card, show the checkpoint, the state inspection ("did not take effect, so a retry is safe"), attempt 2 succeeding and the independent verification.
5. **1:40–2:05 Approval.** Rook pauses at revocation. As Sam (analyst) the approve button isn't there. Switch to Priya (approver) and approve. The step runs and the old key is rejected.
6. **2:05–2:25 Verified Closure.** Show 13/13 checks with evidence, then download the evidence pack, which shows the hash chain intact. Switch to Eve (other org) and the incident isn't visible.

Generated from real runs in the build environment on 2026-10-10 (UTC). Re-run with the commands below.

input.title: Rook: an IT incident agent with Verified Closure (offboarding and service-outage playbooks)
input.body:
Before: Rook handled a single credential incident. It revoked the leaked key first and repaired the app afterwards. billing-app was down for several steps, and a persistent failure left it broken. The API had no authentication, and nothing was traced.

After: Rook is an operations agent for growing companies. One engine resolves different incident types through playbooks, and each one closes only on independently probed evidence.
- **Access & offboarding:** starts from the offboarding ticket and finds every service using the key, including one the vault doesn't record. Issues a replacement, moves each service, and revokes the old key only after a person approves. Rolls back a service that breaks on the new key, then removes the dead key from the repo. 13 closure checks.
- **Service outage:** ties the alert to the deploy that caused it and pauses auto-deploy so it can't undo the fix. Rolls back to a known-good revision, checks that a test order goes through, and resumes the pipeline with the bad revision blocked. If the rollback doesn't help, Rook escalates and leaves the pipeline paused on purpose. 7 closure checks.

Every failure is reconciled against real state before a retry. The audit log is hash-chained. The API authenticates every route and scopes incidents per organisation. The agent emits neatlogs sessions with guardrail and tool spans. The dashboard can be served from Cloudflare Pages in front of the agent's AWS container. Setup targets Ubuntu on WSL.

How:
- Playbooks (trigger, investigation, plan, closure checks) live in `rook/playbooks.py`, on top of five stateful sandbox adapters with deterministic failure injection (`rook/sandbox.py`).
- Dependency-ordered planning, policy re-checked before each action (including R4 safe order and R8 known-good rollback), compensation, checkpoints and run leases are in `rook/engine.py`, `rook/policy.py` and `rook/store.py`.
- Observers that never read tool responses are in `rook/verification.py`.
- `rook/api.py` is a FastAPI factory with bearer auth and an evidence-pack export.
- `web/` is a Next.js dashboard with a Pages Function proxy.
- The Dockerfile and AWS Lightsail script sit alongside `scripts/setup-wsl.sh` and `scripts/dev.sh`, with step-by-step setup in `deploy/README.md`.

80 tests pass on Python 3.13 and 3.14. Measured runs and the partner evidence status are in `evidence/`.

"""Redact given literals from local Entire checkpoint refs not yet on origin, verify, then push them.

Usage: python3 push_checkpoints.py <repo> <literal>...
"""
import os, subprocess, sys

repo, needles = sys.argv[1], [n.encode() for n in sys.argv[2:]]
IDX = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "entire-index")


def git(*a, inp=None, index=False):
    env = dict(os.environ, GIT_INDEX_FILE=IDX) if index else None
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", repo, *a], input=inp, capture_output=True, check=True, env=env).stdout


def blobs(commit):
    for e in filter(None, git("ls-tree", "-r", "-z", commit).split(b"\0")):
        meta, path = e.split(b"\t", 1)
        mode, typ, sha = meta.split()
        yield mode, typ, sha.decode(), path


remote = {l.split()[1] for l in git("ls-remote", "origin", "refs/entire/checkpoints/*").decode().splitlines()}
for ref in git("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/entire/checkpoints/").decode().split():
    if ref in remote:
        continue
    old = git("rev-parse", ref).decode().strip()
    lines, hits = [], 0
    for mode, typ, sha, path in blobs(old):
        data = git("cat-file", "blob", sha)
        for n in needles:
            hits += data.count(n)
            data = data.replace(n, b"[redacted]")
        new = git("hash-object", "-w", "--stdin", inp=data).strip()
        lines.append(b"%s %s %s\t%s" % (mode, typ, new, path))
    if os.path.exists(IDX):
        os.remove(IDX)

# Claude Code agent proxy

Outbound HTTPS from this session goes through a local proxy at http://127.0.0.1:33387
(set via HTTPS_PROXY) which tunnels to a policy-enforcing egress proxy. TLS is
re-terminated there, so every tool must trust the CA bundle at
/root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt. The standard CA environment variables, the system trust
store (where possible), a JVM truststore, the Bazel system bazelrc, the
browser NSS store, and gsutil's boto config are already set up.

## Quick diagnosis

1. Run: curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:33387/__agentproxy/status
   It reports proxy state, which trust and git accommodations are active
   (javaTrustStorePath, toolTrustFailureCodes, gitSshRewrite,
   gitConfigConflicts), and the most recent proxy-side failures.
2. Find the failure class below and apply the matching fix; gitConfigConflicts
   codes map to the git section, toolTrustFailureCodes to the JVM section.
3. Never disable TLS verification, never unset HTTPS_PROXY, and do not retry
   organization policy denials (403/407) — report them instead.

## Failure classes and fixes

### "certificate verify failed" / "self-signed certificate in chain" / PKIX errors

The failing tool is not reading the pre-set CA configuration. In order:

- If the tool has a CA flag or env var, point it at /root/.ccr/ca-bundle.crt
  (examples: --cacert, SSL_CERT_FILE, NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS, REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE,
  AWS_CA_BUNDLE, DENO_CERT, CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO, PIP_CERT, GIT_SSL_CAINFO,
  BUNDLE_SSL_CA_CERT, HEX_CACERTS_PATH, NIX_SSL_CERT_FILE).
- Tool config files override environment variables. If one of these sets its
  own CA or disables verification, point it at the bundle instead:
  pip.conf "cert", npm "cafile" (npm config get cafile), ~/.curlrc "cacert",
  .wgetrc "ca_certificate", conda "ssl_verify", git "http.sslCAInfo",
  gradle.properties / MAVEN_OPTS "-Djavax.net.ssl.trustStore".
- JVM tools (Maven, Gradle, plain Java): when a JDK is present,
  JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS points JVMs at a truststore that holds the proxy CA: the
  JDK's own store if the system trust install already added the CA there,
  otherwise /root/.ccr/java-truststore.p12 (password "changeit"). Confirm
  javaTrustStorePath is set in the status output before pointing a build at it
  (toolTrustFailureCodes explains why it is missing). If the image or the
  build sets its own trustStore, that one wins — import the proxy CA into it
  with
  keytool -importcert -noprompt -alias ccr-agent-proxy -file /root/.ccr/agent-proxy-ca.crt -keystore <their store>
  or point the build at the ready-made one. Bazel reads the managed block in
  /etc/bazel.bazelrc rather than JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS.

### "405 Method Not Allowed" from the proxy

The tool sent a plain-HTTP (non-CONNECT) request: usually axios older than
1.16.1 (upgrade it) or a tool configured with HTTP_PROXY (unset HTTP_PROXY for
that tool — only HTTPS_PROXY is supported).

### 403 / 407 from the proxy

The destination host is not allowed by your organization's egress policy for
this session. Do not retry or route around it — report the blocked host.
Note: curl hides response bodies on failed CONNECTs; the status endpoint
records the reason.

### "connection reset" / "unexpected disconnect" / "RPC failed" mid-transfer

Once a tunnel is up the proxy cannot send an error response, so a connection
it aborts (tunnel to the egress proxy lost, or an upload the tunnel stopped
accepting) reaches the tool as a bare reset. recentRelayFailures in the status
output names the host and reason; check it before concluding the remote
service refused the operation.

### Tool ignores the proxy entirely (timeouts with no proxy error)

Some clients do not read HTTPS_PROXY: Node's built-in fetch (run that command
with NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 on Node >= 22.21), aiohttp (pass trust_env=True),
Ruby bundler (reads only HTTP_PROXY, which this proxy does not serve),
hand-rolled Go dialers. Prefer the tool's own proxy option where one exists.

automatically unless this session has its own SSH setup or supplies its own

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Copy Entire checkpoints from local git refs into .entire/checkpoints/<id>/ as ordinary files.

Entire stores checkpoints as git refs (refs/entire/checkpoints/*). Those refs only travel with an
explicit push, so this script also writes each checkpoint as plain files that are committed with the
code and merge into main with it. Per checkpoint it keeps the metadata, the prompt and the compact
transcript (the full transcript stays in the ref). Email addresses and model identifiers are
redacted on the way out.

    python3 scripts/export-entire-checkpoints.py          # export new checkpoints, then commit them
"""
import json, pathlib, re, subprocess

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / ".entire" / "checkpoints"
EMAIL = re.compile(rb"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@(?!users\.noreply\.github\.com)[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
MODEL = re.compile(rb"claude-(?:opus|sonnet|haiku|fable)-[0-9][0-9a-z.-]*(?:\[1m\])?|\b(?:Opus|Sonnet|Haiku|Fable) [0-9](?:\.[0-9])?\b")


def git(*a):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(ROOT), *a], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout


def clean(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return MODEL.sub(b"[model]", EMAIL.sub(b"[email]", data))


def export(ref):
    cid = ref.rsplit("/", 1)[1]
    dest = OUT / cid
    if dest.exists():
        return None
    top = json.loads(git("show", f"{ref}:metadata.json"))
    dest.mkdir(parents=True)
    (dest / "metadata.json").write_bytes(clean(git("show", f"{ref}:metadata.json")))
    for i, s in enumerate(top.get("sessions", [])):
        for key, name in (("metadata", "session.json"), ("prompt", "prompt.txt"), ("compact_transcript", "transcript.jsonl")):
            path = s.get(key)
            if path:
                data = clean(git("show", f"{ref}:{path.lstrip('/')}"))
                (dest / (name if i == 0 else f"{i}-{name}")).write_bytes(data)
    return cid


def main():
    refs = git("for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname)", "refs/entire/checkpoints/").decode().split()
    done = [c for c in (export(r) for r in refs) if c]
    print("exported: " + (", ".join(done) if done else "nothing new"))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
